svg.title: Goal loop: caller/board authorship (D-GOALS); agent self-goals deferred to SH2+ G2

g.text: Goal loop: caller/board authorship (D-GOALS); agent self-goals deferred to SH2+ G2
Authority and ordering only: goal-client actions/capability shape,
runner proof and goal-free completion path remain unpublished.
Session host §3.8 owns the joint publication/qualification gates.
Goal absence never blocks launch, attach, delivery, wake, stop or recovery.
SH1 retains its existing optional board compatibility seam.
host admission; caller authority, current revision, bounded budget;
agent executor gains no goal-authoring capability
at turn boundary, deliver to current-epoch registered runner
applied, deferred or rolled back with joined error
[while authorised goal active and budget available]
revision, budget and interval checks; host admission
host-authored nudge frame; goal text keeps author's provenance
Pending interactions suspend nudges and turn counting.
No-progress detector remains shadow-only until its activation gate.
CAS, budgets and outcome ownership are retained (GOL §§3-5).
outcome proposal or blocked notice through retained board seam
board owner accepts/refuses; only it changes goal revision/state
park note through existing tail/bridge path
local agent-authored note; no goal revision
Session-token possession gives no goal capability.
Self-goal set/clear/status and board-free agent completion are not enabled.
G2 later chooses bounded self-goals or caller/board authorship only.
